Third pre-release of 1.3.

## Changed

- **Blurb moved into the Metadata area.** It sits below the form; drag the divider to give it more room (double-click puts it back). *Apply* and *Discard* now cover form, blurb and cover together. The separate Blurbs area is gone; its filters (no blurb, blurb only in Calibre) are in the Metadata list. The sidebar now has six areas (Ctrl+1 … 6).
- **Lookup buttons next to what they fill.** *Look up* and *From Calibre* are small buttons above the blurb, the cover has its own below the image. For all books at once there is **Complete ▾** in the toolbar: look up all missing blurbs, all missing covers, or fill gaps from Calibre.
- **Pictograms instead of warning triangles.** The sidebar shows every issue of an area with its count — a speech bubble for missing blurbs, a picture for missing covers, a question mark for questionable chapter names, a light bulb for pending chapter suggestions, a floppy disk for unsaved books, and so on. The book lists show the same pictograms per book. Hover for an explanation; *Help > Status and markers* lists them all.

## Install

- **Linux:** *Help > Check for updates* in an installed copy (with *Settings > Updates > Include pre-releases* on), or `install.sh` from this repository.
- **Windows:** `Bookbench_Setup_1.3-beta3.exe` (not signed yet: SmartScreen > *More info* > *Run anyway*).
